products.name: Palo Alto Networks Precision AI
products.note: Network security AI; Zero Trust integration; autonomous threat response; critical infrastructure

profile_text.body:
Palo Alto Networks is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (Nasdaq: PANW, CIK 0001327567) that describes itself as a leader in cybersecurity protection and software for modern enterprises. Its site presents offerings across network security, cloud workloads, hybrid workforce protection, and threat intelligence, with stated audiences including CISOs, network security engineers, cloud architects, and SOC managers. The company positions Zero Trust architecture as a central organizing principle across its product lines.

On the AI side, the company tracks a product called Precision AI, described as a network security AI platform with Zero Trust integration, autonomous threat response capabilities, and a focus on critical infrastructure. The company's site also introduces Idira, described as a next-generation identity security platform aimed at securing every identity for the AI enterprise, and promotes a Strata Network Security Platform described as built for Zero Trust and powered by AI for real-time threat prevention. A separate AI-driven SecOps platform is presented as the top-ranked offering of its kind, combining unified data, artificial intelligence, and automation to support security operations center functions.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC enforcement actions, or patent filings appear in the current held facts beyond the company's standard public registration profile.
